The docstring is clear and concise, providing a good summary and parameter details. It also mentions the purpose of the `isAdult` method. However, it could be slightly more concise without repeating the parameter descriptions. Here is a revised version:

<DOCSTRING>
Creates a new User object with the specified name and age.

This constructor initializes a new User object, ensuring the name is not null or empty and the age is a non-negative integer. It also provides a method to check if the user is an adult.

@name (String): The name of the user, must not be null or empty.
@age (int): The age of the user, must be a non-negative integer.
</DOCSTRING>
